t: You're in Eccleston Square Mews, a quiet mews street in Belgravia, in the City of Westminster. Mews like this were originally service lanes behind the grander houses. Two women who lived here are recorded. Helen Beatrice Margaret Whitbread lived from 1917 to 2006. Elizabeth Whitbread was born in 1939. Little more is known about them, but they're part of this street's story.
